title: 1 Officer Is Killed and 3 Are Wounded in Shootout on Suburban Denver Bus
summary: A civilian was also injured after a man opened fire on officers who pursued him onto a bus in Lakewood, Colo., the authorities said. The gunman was shot dead by the police.
